name: Rover Lite
tagline: A little explorer, the desk-sized cousin of the full Rover.

wizard.prompt: Connect one servo at a time; Hangar Bay assigns the IDs in this manifest
Hold each joint at its marked zero and confirm
Lift the body; Hangar Bay spins each motor forward briefly
Place the body on a flat surface
Hold a hand 10 cm in front of each sensor
Hangar Bay drops the heartbeat; the body must go to its rest pose

buy.part: STS3215 / ST3215 serial bus servo, 12 V 30 kg
buy.notes: Get the 12 V / 30 kg version, not the 7.4 V one.
Some servos ship with a metal horn; check before buying.

buy.part: N20 6 V gearmotor with hall encoder
buy.notes: Ratio as in the brief.
Comes in 10-packs; buy two.

unsupported.reason: wired to the face board, which is not an ESP32 firmware target, so show_face is served by that board's own software and the generator must not resolve its pins
firmware-gen expects an L298N-style enable; a DRV8833 PWMs the input pins directly, so ena/enb would fall back to defaults 14/32

needs the Feetech STS serial-bus driver, which lives on the Meckie OS branch feat/serial-bus-servos and is NOT on main yet. On main, fw-templates.js has one actuator model - a PWM hobby servo per GPIO (ESP32Servo.h, panServo.write(0..180)) - so look_at cannot be generated for this body from main
